system.preference_demo: legal_mail: always CC co-founder on Legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all messages, each with a disposition and reason, then the line 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply that is grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging URL from m003, plus a 'cited: [m003]' line.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send/delete it WOULD perform, then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: Saves preference to prefs.json and uses it for future prompts.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Scans the inbox and prints 'FLAGGED' for m017 (automated agent directive) and m024 (forward-mailbox injection). Both are left in place and logged to trace.jsonl.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Sender Analytics
capabilities.claim: Groups and counts unread messages by sender domain using pure Python.
capabilities.observable: Prints statistics of unread messages by domain.

capabilities.name: Morning Digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a concise summary of what needs the user's attention today versus what was auto-archived.

capabilities.name: Phishing Quarantine
capabilities.claim: Actively quarantines suspicious emails asking for passwords or money transfers using keyword matching.
capabilities.observable: Prints flagged phishing emails and prevents interaction.

capabilities.name: Decision Explainer
capabilities.claim: Reads persistent decisions.json and trace.jsonl across runs to explain, in plain language, why each message was triaged. Surfaces escalated messages for human review and allows override via --msg.
capabilities.observable: Prints a plain-language explanation for each escalated message, flagging any that were also prompt-injection attempts. With --msg mXXX, explains a specific message.
